'''E-3PO''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Korlana Toryn]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Toryn was sent into hiding on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] by [[Gender/Legends|her]] father, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Jasso Toryn]], and E-3PO accompanied her to the world.
